interface: Analog DC envelope into SIM4 ADC; no audio content exists past the detector

measurands.name: spl_db
measurands.accuracy: ±2-3 dB after single-point calibration [to be characterised on final hardware]

privacy: amplitude only, by hardware; speech is unrecoverable and no policy can change that
failure_modes: flat at the floor (~30 dB) during obvious activity: mic or bias failure
constant high reading: envelope capacitor fault or mechanical vibration on the enclosure
baseline shift after remounting: recalibrate the single-point offset
mounting: away from HVAC outlets and direct mechanical contact with vibrating surfaces
